provenance.notes: Zone C drop (R5-03.S3): the three 21x30 spin frames of the DUST DEVIL vapor funnel are the first three cells (reading order) of the owner-picked animation sheet — the spiral bands advanced a quarter turn each cell, the pebbles at new orbit positions, so the loop closes on the fourth cell which stays unused (the slot has three frames; the roster's dust-devil animation is 3 frames at 4 ticks). Cropped from the committed winner with a 6-px key border, shrunk on two sides where the sheet's cell-border frame and stray speckles sat inside it; the crop rings were probed to zero foreign pixels. The enemy is currently placed by no shipped stage (its dune.whirl pattern is registered, the route runs none) — the sprite rides the common atlas page and this redraw only restiles it at the design. The design carries its own 1-px near-black navy outline, so the outline pass is off. The palette is fixed to the sheet's fifteen design colours (a maroon-core, red and rust-to-cream ramp): an adaptive sixteen admits key-blend rim pixels as two olive greens the design never has, so the fixed list keeps the cap clear and sends the rim to its nearest design colour.
